If a resolver could not resolve a name, there's currently no way to report error back to ClientConn, and RPCs on the ClientConn will fail with timeout.

This method allows resolver to report error to ClientConn, and failfast RPCs should fail with this error (or RPC errors that contain info from this error).

item.text: The benchmark corpus includes the exact expected change set for issue #2951. It confirms this is broader than adding a callback: resolver errors must be forwarded into the balancer, while the picker must retain the latest error so fail-fast calls return promptly with its details. I’m extracting the relevant hunks and adapting them to this checkout’s older API.
